comment: Adje reads every input with getVoltage() rather than getPolyVoltage, which the maker's manual states plainly: the CV inputs are monophonic and the polyphony is only on the outputs, where the channel count comes from the Channels menu item rather than from any jack. The octave knob is rounded unconditionally at Adje.cpp:141, so unlike Ad's pitch knob there is no continuous option for it. The number-of-partials CV is scaled 1.4 per volt against Ad's 0.7, and pushing the total below zero flips the sign of the stretch (line 191), which has no equivalent on Ad.
